<h2 id="11-二分--双指针">1.1 二分 &amp; 双指针</h2>
<p>关联博文：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Atserckcn/p/19124798" target="_blank">Atserkcn-0/1分数规划</a></p>
<h3 id="p1404-平均数"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P1404" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P1404 平均数</a></h3>
<p>既然要让子串平均数最大，那就二分平均数，判断能否达到即可。复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log V)\)</span>。</p>
<p>关联题目：<a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/U614651" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">[2025国庆集训Day2C] course</a></p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">signed main(){ 
	read(n), read(m); 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) read(a[i]), a[i] *= 10000, Max = max(Max, a[i]); 
	int l = 0, r = Max; 
	while(l &lt;= r) {
		int mid = (l + r) &gt;&gt; 1; 
		bool flag = 0; int minn = 0; 
		for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
			s[i] = s[i - 1] + (a[i] - mid); 
			if(i &gt;= m) {
				minn = min(minn, s[i - m]); 
				if(s[i] &gt; minn) {
					flag = 1; 
					break; 
				}
			} 
		} 
		if(flag) l = mid + 1; 
		else r = mid - 1; 
	}
	fwr(l / 10);
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<h3 id="p4047-jsoi2010-部落划分"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P4047" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P4047 [JSOI2010] 部落划分</a></h3>
<p>要求距离最远的部落距离最小，依然二分答案。但是判定时需要贪心地选择最近的两个部落合并，需要用到并查集维护集合。时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2\log V\times \alpha(n))\)</span>。</p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">int find(register int x) {
	return fa[x] == x ? x : fa[x] = find(fa[x]); 
}
double mx, my; 
inline bool chk(double mid) {
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) fa[i] = i; 
	int cnt = 0; 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) for(register int j = 1; j &lt;= n; j++) {
		if((x[j] - x[i]) * (x[j] - x[i]) + (y[j] - y[i]) * (y[j] - y[i]) &lt;= mid) {
			fa[find(i)] = find(j); 
		}
	} 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) if(find(i) == i) cnt++; 
	return cnt &gt;= k; 
}
int main(){
	read(n); read(k); 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		read(x[i]), read(y[i]);
		mx = max(1.0 * x[i], mx), my = max(1.0 * y[i], my);  
	} 
	double l = 0, r = mx * mx + my * my, mid; 
	while(r - l &gt; 1e-4) {
		mid = (l + r) / 2; 
		if(chk(mid)) l = mid; 
		else r = mid; 
	} 
	printf("%.2lf\n", sqrt(l)); 
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<h3 id="p6004-wormhole-sort-s"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P6004" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P6004 Wormhole Sort S</a></h3>
<p><s>奶牛为什么要钻虫洞？</s></p>
<p>要求最大化被奶牛用来排序的虫洞宽度的最小值，还是二分答案。</p>
<p>考虑二分最小虫洞宽度。先对每个虫洞的宽度排序，然后判定的时候把满足 <span class="math inline">\(w\ge mid\)</span> 的虫洞两端点用并查集合并到一起，最后看每个 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 是否在同一集合内就行了。时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log n + n\log V)\)</span>。</p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">struct Edge {
	int u, v, w; 
} a[N]; 
int n, m, p[N], fa[N], cw[N], tot, ans;  
int find(register int x) {
	return fa[x] == x ? x : fa[x] = find(fa[x]); 
}
inline bool cmp(const Edge &amp;x, const Edge &amp;y) {
	return x.w &gt; y.w; 
}
inline bool chk(register int x) {
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) fa[i] = i; 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) { 
		if(a[i].w &lt; x) break; 
		register int f1 = find(a[i].u), f2 = find(a[i].v);  
		fa[f1] = f2; 
	} 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= tot; i++) {
		if(find(p[cw[i]]) != find(cw[i])) return false; 
	} 
	return true; 
}
int main(){
	read(n); read(m); 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		read(p[i]); 
		if(p[i] != i) cw[++tot] = i; 
	}    
	if(!tot) return fwr(-1), 0; 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) read(a[i].u), read(a[i].v), read(a[i].w); 
	sort(a + 1, a + m + 1, cmp);  
	int l = a[m].w, r = a[1].w, mid; 
	while(l &lt;= r) {
		mid = (l + r) &gt;&gt; 1; 
		if(chk(mid)) l = mid + 1, ans = mid; 
		else r = mid - 1; 
	} 
	fwr(ans);  
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<h3 id="p4064-jxoi2017-加法"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P4064" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P4064 [JXOI2017] 加法</a></h3>
<p>可以二分题目要求的 <span class="math inline">\(\min\{a_i\}\)</span>，但是判定很麻烦。</p>
<p>我们贪心地想，从左往右扫一遍，遇到小于 <span class="math inline">\(mid\)</span> 的 <span class="math inline">\(a_i\)</span> 就直接用包含它的 <span class="math inline">\(l,r\)</span> 执行操作直到它足够大，但是这个操作对区间内其他元素也有影响，要用树状数组维护。</p>
<p>但是区间的使用是有限制的，考虑取用区间时按照右端点排序，这样可以贡献到更多后面未知元素。同时要弹出右端点在 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 之前的区间，用优先队列可以实现这一整个过程。</p>
<p>参考的题解说预先要按照左端点排序，但是事实上与优先队列采用一致的排序方式也不影响。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">const int N = 2e5 + 5; 
const long long INF = 1e18; 
int T, n, m, k, a;
long long A[N], c[N]; 
struct Segs {
	int l, r; 
	bool operator &lt; (const Segs &amp;rhs) const { return r &lt; rhs.r; }
} seg[N]; 
inline int lbt(register int x) { return x &amp; -x; }
inline void upd(register int x, register int d) { while(x &lt;= n) c[x] += d, x += lbt(x); return; }
inline int qry(register int x) { int res = 0; while(x) res += c[x], x -= lbt(x); return res; } 
inline bool cmp(const Segs &amp;x, const Segs &amp; y) {
	if(x.l == y.l) return x.r &gt; y.r; 
	return x.l &lt; y.l;              
} 
priority_queue&lt;Segs&gt; q; 
inline void init() {
	while(!q.empty()) q.pop(); 
	memset(c, 0, sizeof(c)); 
	return; 
} 
inline bool chk(int x) { 
	init(); 
	int rec = 1, cnt = 0; 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) upd(i, A[i] - A[i - 1]);  
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) { 
		while(rec &lt;= m &amp;&amp; seg[rec].l &lt;= i) {
			q.push(seg[rec]);
			rec++;  
		}
		while(qry(i) &lt; x &amp;&amp; !q.empty()) { 
			Segs t; 
			do {
				t = q.top(); 
				q.pop(); 
			} while(t.r &lt; i &amp;&amp; !q.empty());  
			cnt++; 
			if(cnt &gt; k || t.r &lt; i) return false; 
			upd(t.l, a); upd(t.r + 1, -a);  
		} 
		if(qry(i) &lt; x) return false;  
	} 
	return true; 
}
void Main() {
	read(n); read(m); read(k); read(a);  
	long long l = INF, r = 0, mid, ans = 0; 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		read(A[i]); 
		l = min(l, A[i]); r = max(r, A[i]); 
	} 
	for(register int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) {
		read(seg[i].l); read(seg[i].r);  
	}
	sort(seg + 1, seg + m + 1, cmp); 
	r += k * a; 
	while(l &lt;= r) {
		mid = (l + r) &gt;&gt; 1; 
		if(chk(mid)) l = mid + 1, ans = mid; 
		else r = mid - 1; 
	} 
	fwr(ans); 
	return putchar('\n'), void(); 
}

signed main(){
	read(T); while(T--) Main(); 
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="cf1731d-valiants-new-map"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1731D" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF1731D Valiant's New Map</a></h3>
<p>本题有个技巧是二分判定时预先把矩阵变成 01 矩阵，再做二维前缀和找和为 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span> 的正方形就行了。</p>
<h3 id="p2824-heoi2016tjoi2016-排序"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P2824" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P2824 [HEOI2016/TJOI2016] 排序</a></h3>
<p><s>放我做题计划里多久了？忘了</s></p>
<p>一眼线段树。但是这题实际上是离线的，线段树主要起到辅助二分判定的作用。</p>
<p>正常排序是 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log n)\)</span> 的，显然太慢。本题需要一个更快捷的排序，那就是 01 排序。</p>
<p>01 排序只需要记一下 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 的个数，然后区间统一修改就行了。应用到本题，即二分答案 <span class="math inline">\(mid\)</span>，然后大于等于 <span class="math inline">\(mid\)</span> 的全标记成 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>，否则标记成 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>，如果判定后 <span class="math inline">\(mid\)</span> 为 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 左端点后移，否则右端点前移。线段树上查询和上传修改操作全部都是 <span class="math inline">\(O(\log n)\)</span> 的，判定复杂度就是 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log n)\)</span>，总复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log^2 n)\)</span>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
const int N = 1e5 + 5; 
int n, m, q; 
int a[N], op[N], L[N], R[N]; 
struct SGT {
	int l, r, val, lzy; 
} tr[N &lt;&lt; 2]; 
void pushup(int rt) {
	tr[rt].val = tr[(rt &lt;&lt; 1)].val + tr[(rt &lt;&lt; 1 | 1)].val; 
	return; 
}
void rebuild(int l, int r, int rt, int mid) {
	tr[rt].l = l, tr[rt].r = r, tr[rt].lzy = 0; 
	if(l == r) {
		if(a[l] &gt;= mid) tr[rt].val = 1; 
		else tr[rt].val = 0; 
		return; 
	} 
	int md = (l + r) &gt;&gt; 1; 
	rebuild(l, md, (rt &lt;&lt; 1), mid); 
	rebuild(md + 1, r, (rt &lt;&lt; 1 | 1), mid); 
	pushup(rt); 
	return; 
}
void pushdown(int rt) {
	if(tr[rt].lzy) {
		tr[rt &lt;&lt; 1].lzy = tr[rt &lt;&lt; 1 | 1].lzy = tr[rt].lzy; 
		int mid = (tr[rt].l + tr[rt].r) &gt;&gt; 1; 
		if(tr[rt].lzy == 1) tr[(rt &lt;&lt; 1)].val = mid - tr[rt].l + 1, tr[(rt &lt;&lt; 1 | 1)].val = tr[rt].r - mid; 
		else tr[rt &lt;&lt; 1].val = tr[rt &lt;&lt; 1 | 1].val = 0;  
		tr[rt].lzy = 0; 
	} 
	return; 
} 
int qry(int l, int r, int rt, int ql, int qr) {
	if(ql &lt;= l &amp;&amp; r &lt;= qr) return tr[rt].val; 
	if(ql &gt; r || qr &lt; l) return 0; 
	pushdown(rt); 
	int mid = (l + r) &gt;&gt; 1; 
	return qry(l, mid, rt &lt;&lt; 1, ql, qr) + qry(mid + 1, r, rt &lt;&lt; 1 | 1, ql, qr); 
}
int check(int l, int r, int rt, int p) {
	if(l == p &amp;&amp; r == p) return tr[rt].val; 
	pushdown(rt); 
	int mid = (l + r) &gt;&gt; 1; 
	if(p &lt;= mid) return check(l, mid, (rt &lt;&lt; 1), p); 
	else return check(mid + 1, r, (rt &lt;&lt; 1 | 1), p); 
}
void upd(int l, int r, int rt, int ql, int qr, int v) {
	if(ql &lt;= l &amp;&amp; qr &gt;= r) {
		tr[rt].val = v * (r - l + 1); 
		tr[rt].lzy = v ? 1 : -1; 
		return; 
	} 
	if(ql &gt; r || qr &lt; l) return; 
	pushdown(rt); 
	int mid = (l + r) &gt;&gt; 1; 
	upd(l, mid, (rt &lt;&lt; 1), ql, qr, v); 
	upd(mid + 1, r, rt &lt;&lt; 1 | 1, ql, qr, v); 
	pushup(rt); 
}
bool chk(int mid) {
	rebuild(1, n, 1, mid); 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) {
		int cnt1 = qry(1, n, 1, L[i], R[i]); 
		if(op[i] == 0) {
			upd(1, n, 1, R[i] - cnt1 + 1, R[i], 1); 
			upd(1, n, 1, L[i], R[i] - cnt1, 0); 
		} 
		else {
			upd(1, n, 1, L[i], L[i] + cnt1 - 1, 1); 
			upd(1, n, 1, L[i] + cnt1, R[i], 0);   
		}
	} 
	return check(1, n, 1, q); 
}
int main(){
	cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; m; 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		cin &gt;&gt; a[i]; 
	} 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) {
		cin &gt;&gt; op[i] &gt;&gt; L[i] &gt;&gt; R[i]; 
	} 
	cin &gt;&gt; q; 
	int l = 1, r = n, mid, ans; 
	while(l &lt;= r) {
		mid = (l + r) &gt;&gt; 1; 
		if(chk(mid)) l = mid + 1, ans = mid; 
		else r = mid - 1; 
	}
	cout &lt;&lt; ans; 
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="abc136e-max-gcd"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/AT_abc136_e" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">ABC136E Max GCD</a></h3>
<p>本文可以在题解区找到。</p>
<p>多好的一道思维题！</p>
<p>蒟蒻觉得大佬们双指针贪心部分讲得有些简略，故写一篇题解来具体说说自己的想法。</p>
<p>首先，我们要发现一个重要的性质：记最终的答案为 <span class="math inline">\(ans\)</span>，那么 <span class="math inline">\(ans\)</span> 一定整除 <span class="math inline">\(\sum_{i=1}^{n} A_i\)</span>。因为无论怎么操作序列的和都不变，且最后必须保证 <span class="math inline">\(ans\)</span> 是所有 <span class="math inline">\(A_i\)</span> 的公约数。</p>
<p>那么，我们记 <span class="math inline">\(sum=\sum_{i=1}^{n} A_i\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(ans\)</span> 一定是 <span class="math inline">\(sum\)</span> 的因子。那就需要枚举 <span class="math inline">\(sum\)</span> 的因子，合法的最大因子就是 <span class="math inline">\(ans\)</span>。</p>
<p>接下来就是判断是否合法。当考察因子 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 时，考虑记录每个 <span class="math inline">\(B_i=A_i \bmod x\)</span>，并将它们<strong>从小到大</strong>排序，接着进行双指针扫描，贪心地计算所需操作次数 <span class="math inline">\(cnt\)</span>，若 <span class="math inline">\(cnt\le k\)</span> 则合法。记左指针为 <span class="math inline">\(l\)</span>，右指针为 <span class="math inline">\(r\)</span>，具体贪心实现如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>若 <span class="math inline">\(B_l+B_r=x\)</span>，那么操作 <span class="math inline">\(B_l\)</span> 次 <span class="math inline">\(B_l,B_r\)</span> 就可以都变成 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(cnt\)</span> 加上 <span class="math inline">\(B_l\)</span>，两个指针都向中间靠 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 个坐标。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>若 <span class="math inline">\(B_l+B_r&lt;x\)</span>，那么钦定操作 <span class="math inline">\(B_l\)</span> 次使得 <span class="math inline">\(B_l\)</span> 变成 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(B_r\)</span> 变成 <span class="math inline">\(B_r+B_l\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(cnt\)</span> 加上 <span class="math inline">\(B_l\)</span>，左指针向中间靠 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 个坐标。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>若 <span class="math inline">\(B_l+B_r&gt;x\)</span>，那么钦定操作 <span class="math inline">\(x-B_r\)</span> 次使得 <span class="math inline">\(B_r\)</span> 变成 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，相当于变成 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(B_l\)</span> 变成 <span class="math inline">\(B_l-x+B_r\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(cnt\)</span> 加上 <span class="math inline">\(x-B_r\)</span>，右指针向中间靠 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 个坐标。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>如果你对后两个操作有疑问，如“为什么要这样钦定”，请代入前提条件“已经将 <span class="math inline">\(B_i\)</span> 从小到大排序”。</p>
<p>那么本题就完成了，时间复杂度是 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log n\sqrt {sum})\)</span>。但实际上肯定要比这个快，因为 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log n)\)</span> 是检查因数时排序的复杂度。</p>
<p><a href="https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc136/submissions/69931030" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">提交记录。</a></p>
<h2 id="12-贪心">1.2 贪心</h2>
<h3 id="p8898-feeding-the-cows-b"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/solution/P8898" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P8898 Feeding the Cows B</a></h3>
<p>注意到有的地方如果种了草，那么它所能影响的范围内均不需要种草。那就考虑在从左往右扫的时候，如果 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 没被覆盖，就不断从 <span class="math inline">\(i+k\)</span> 往前看能不能种，如果能种就直接跳出。</p>
<p>时间复杂度大概 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log n)\)</span>。</p>
<h3 id="p3545-poi-2012-hur-warehouse-store"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/solution/P3545" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P3545 [POI 2012] HUR-Warehouse Store</a></h3>
<p>经典的贪心+堆维护。</p>
<p>最优肯定是全部都满足，但是大概率不可能。考虑能满足就满足，遇到不能满足的就把前面满足的人里买的最多的那个人踢出去（如果踢掉他就能满足当前的人），这样就能保证答案最大化。</p>
<p>用大根堆维护即可，复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log n)\)</span>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">struct node {
	int id, mon; 
	bool operator &lt; (const node &amp;rhs) const {
		return mon &lt; rhs.mon; 
	}   
};
priority_queue&lt;node&gt; q; 
signed main() {
	rd(n); 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		rd(a[i]); 
	}
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		rd(b[i]); 
	} 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		sum += a[i]; 
		if(sum &lt; b[i]) {
			if(!q.empty() &amp;&amp; q.top().mon &gt; b[i]) {
				vis[q.top().id] = 0; 
				sum += q.top().mon; 
				q.pop(); 
                --ans;
			} 
        }
        if(sum &gt;= b[i]) {
            sum -= b[i]; 
            q.push((node){i, b[i]}); 
            vis[i] = 1; 
            ++ans; 
        }
	} 
	fp(ans); hh(); 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++, kg()) {
		if(vis[i]) fp(i); 
	} 
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="p4053-jsoi2007-建筑抢修"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P4053" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P4053 [JSOI2007] 建筑抢修</a></h3>
<p>贪心+堆模型。</p>
<p>限制时间短的建筑肯定更要紧，所以先按照它升序排序。</p>
<p>接下来就是自然的贪心。如果有建筑需要报废，那必然选择报废维修时间最长那个来争取维修更多建筑。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">struct Build {
	int t1, t2; 
} a[N];      
priority_queue&lt;pii&gt;q; 
bool cmp(Build x, Build y) {
	return x.t2 &lt; y.t2; 
} 
signed main() {
	rd(n); 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		rd(a[i].t1); rd(a[i].t2); 
	}
	sort(a + 1, a + n + 1, cmp); 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		sum += a[i].t1; 
		q.push({a[i].t1, i}); 
		if(sum &lt;= a[i].t2) ans++; 
		else sum -= q.top().first, q.pop(); 
	} 
	fp(ans); 
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="13-搜索--模拟">1.3 搜索 &amp; 模拟</h2>
<h3 id="p12684-叉叉学习魔法"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P12684" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P12684 叉叉学习魔法</a></h3>
<p>考虑直接 bfs，容易想到记录当前位置、最小步数 <span class="math inline">\(t1\)</span> 和最少魔法使用次数 <span class="math inline">\(t2\)</span>，用堆维护可以做到 <span class="math inline">\(O(nm\log (nm))\)</span>。但是这样会超时倒闭，所以考虑用 01bfs，将 <span class="math inline">\(t1+1\)</span> 的新状态加到队尾，<span class="math inline">\(t2+1\)</span> 的新状态加到队头，这样相当于线性维护了之前的堆，可以把 <span class="math inline">\(\log\)</span> 去掉做到 <span class="math inline">\(O(nm)\)</span>。当然，在此之前 <span class="math inline">\(t1,t2\)</span> 没改的状态要从队头取出，否则会破坏单调性。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;iostream&gt;
#include &lt;deque&gt; 
#include &lt;vector&gt;
using namespace std;
const int N = 5005; 
int n, m, x1, y1, x2, y2; 
char a[N][N];  
bool vis[N][N];  
struct node {
	int x, y, t1, t2; 
	bool operator &lt; (const node &amp;rhs) const {
		if(t1 != rhs.t1) return t1 &gt; rhs.t1; 
		return t2 &gt; rhs.t2; 
	}
}; 
deque&lt;node&gt; q; 
vector&lt;node&gt; v1, v2; 
const int dx1[] = {-1, 1, 0, 0}, dy1[] = {0, 0, -1, 1}; 
const int dx2[] = {-1, -1, 1, 1}, dy2[] = {-1, 1, -1, 1}; 
void _01bfs() {
	q.push_front((node){x1, y1, 0, 0}); 
	while(!q.empty()) {
		node u = q.front(); 
		while(!q.empty() &amp;&amp; u.t1 == q.front().t1 &amp;&amp; u.t2 == q.front().t2) {
			u = q.front(); 
			q.pop_front(); 
			if(u.x == x2 &amp;&amp; u.y == y2) {
				printf("%d %d", u.t1, u.t2); 
				return; 
			} 
			if(vis[u.x][u.y]) continue; 
			vis[u.x][u.y] = 1; 
			for(int i = 0; i &lt; 4; i++) {
				int nx = u.x + dx1[i], ny = u.y + dy1[i]; 
				if(!nx || !ny || nx == n + 1 || ny == m + 1 || a[nx][ny] == '#') continue; 
				v1.push_back({nx, ny, u.t1 + 1, u.t2}); 
			}
			for(int i = 0; i &lt; 4; i++) {
				int nx = u.x + dx2[i], ny = u.y + dy2[i]; 
				if(!nx || !ny || nx == n + 1 || ny == m + 1 || a[nx][ny] == '#') continue; 
				v2.push_back({nx, ny, u.t1, u.t2 + 1}); 
			}
		}
		for(auto v : v2) q.push_front(v); 
		for(auto v : v1) q.push_back(v); 
		v1.clear(), v2.clear(); 
	}
	printf("-1 -1"); 
	return; 
}
int main() {
	scanf("%d %d", &amp;n, &amp;m); 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		scanf("%s", a[i] + 1); 
		for(int j = 1; j &lt;= m; j++) { 
			if(a[i][j] == 'X') x1 = i, y1 = j; 
			else if(a[i][j] == 'W') x2 = i, y2 = j;  
		}
	} 
	_01bfs();  
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="p8817-csp-s-2022-假期计划"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P8817" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P8817 [CSP-S 2022] 假期计划</a></h3>
<p>布什戈门，说好的折半呢？？？这哪里有啊？</p>
<p>先暴力处理两两之间的连通性，复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span>。处理的时候每个点存可以抵达的点中权值最大的三个点。最后算答案的时候直接四重循环更新答案，但是由于我们之前存的是三个可以抵达的最大权值点，所以显然复杂度只有 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt; 
#define int long long
using namespace std;
const int N = 2505, M = 20005;    
inline void rd(int &amp;x) {scanf("%lld", &amp;x);}
inline void fp(int &amp;x) {printf("%lld", x);}
inline void hh() {putchar('\n');}
inline void kg() {putchar(' '); } 
int n, m, k, val[N]; 
int head[N], totot; 
int dis[N];  
bool to[N][N];  
vector&lt;int&gt; g[N];  
struct EDGE {int nxt, to; } edge[M]; 
inline void addedge(int u, int v) {
	edge[++totot].to = v, edge[totot].nxt = head[u], head[u] = totot; 
	return;       
} 
inline bool cmp(int x, int y) {
	return val[x] &gt; val[y]; 
}
inline void bfs(int x) { 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) dis[i] = -1; 
	dis[x] = 0; 
	queue&lt;int&gt; q; 
	q.push(x); 
	while(!q.empty()) {
		int u = q.front(); 
		q.pop(); 
		if(u != x) {
			to[x][u] = 1; 
			if(x != 1 &amp;&amp; to[1][u]) {
				g[x].push_back(u); 
				sort(g[x].begin(), g[x].end(), cmp); 
				if(g[x].size() &gt; 3) g[x].pop_back(); 
			} 
		} 
		if(dis[u] == k + 1) continue; 
		for(int i = head[u]; i; i = edge[i].nxt) {
			int v = edge[i].to; 
			if(dis[v] == -1) {
				dis[v] = dis[u] + 1; 
				q.push(v); 
			}
		}
	}
}
signed main() {
	rd(n), rd(m), rd(k); 
	for(int i = 2; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		rd(val[i]); 
	}                     
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) {
    	int x, y; rd(x), rd(y); 
    	addedge(x, y), addedge(y, x); 
	} 
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++) bfs(i);  
	int ans = 0; 
	for(int i = 2; i &lt;= n; i++) {
		for(int j = 2; j &lt;= n; j++) {
			if(to[i][j]) {
				for(int k : g[i]) {
					for(int l : g[j]) {
						if(j != k &amp;&amp; i != l &amp;&amp; k != l) {
							ans = max(ans, val[i] + val[j] + val[k] + val[l]); 
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	} 
	fp(ans); 
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
